rule: An unresolved conflict blocks promotion of the stronger dependent claim. Engineering sources remain authoritative for resolution; the language system records impact and release controls.

conflicts.summary: STATUS.md says a wired ModelCanvas with shared selection is current, then says the 3D stack has zero consumers and no 3D surface exists.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Do not market or answer disputed 3D reachability as settled.

conflicts.summary: The repository records unresolved overlap between the SQLite-WASM/OPFS native direction and the tested Dexie/IndexedDB implementation used by the demo journal.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Name the concrete persistence tier. A journal write never implies portable-file publication.

requires: An ADR resolving the persistence relationship.
A tested open/write flow for the chosen portable-file claim.

conflicts.summary: Public home copy describes a local .arq file that opens in the browser, while FileOpenPanel deliberately stops at compatibility preflight.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Use compatible/preflight wording until a live open pipeline is user-reachable.

requires: Promote only after a browser opening-path test.

conflicts.summary: Public copy can read as though door, window and room authoring are current while STATUS says these tools are not wired to the canvas.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Distinguish implemented libraries or designed controls from user-reachable authoring.

requires: Correct current-state copy or wire and test the tools.

conflicts.summary: Public interoperability copy says every import produces a report while STATUS says no import/export path is reachable end-to-end in the product.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Describe tested adapters and the required future report contract separately from a shipped flow.

requires: Add UI integration and fidelity-report tests before promotion.

conflicts.summary: Student copy says a modest laptop is enough without named hardware/browser benchmark evidence.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Use tested environments or remove the broad device claim.

requires: Published named benchmark profiles and thresholds, or revised copy.

conflicts.summary: Security copy says the development build sends nothing anywhere, an absolute transport claim not bound to an approved network-observation evidence source.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Scope the statement to verified behaviour and approved policy; do not use an absolute without proof.

requires: Network-observation test and approved privacy statement, or revised copy.

conflicts.summary: AI marketing can describe guardrails as a currently enforced kernel capability while no AI-driven product feature is current.
conflicts.downstreamRule: State the contract as a requirement for future AI capability, not as a current shipped feature.

requires: Correct wording or ship a tested proposal flow.

conflicts.summary: Public copy includes exact or loose test counts without a generated evidence artifact.
conflicts.downstreamRule: Remove counts or render them from a CI-generated, freshness-checked artifact.

requires: Generated evidence artifact or revised copy.
